stray.definition:
n. an animal that has strayed (especially a domestic animal)
v. wander from a direct course or at random
s. (of an animal) having no home or having wandered away from home
stray.translation:
n. 走失的家畜, 浪子
a. 迷途的, 偶然的
vi. 迷路, 彷徨, 流浪

stray capacity.translation: [计] 杂散电容, 寄生电容

strayed.translation: v. 走失( stray的过去式和过去分词 ); 偏离正题; 走入歧途; （已婚者或有固定关系者）有外遇

strayer.definition:
n someone who strays or falls behind
s not close together in time
s (of an animal) having no home or having wandered away from home
strayer.translation:
n. 迷失者
[法] 迷失者

straying.definition: s. unable to find your way
straying.translation: v. 走失( stray的现在分词 ); 偏离正题; 走入歧途; （已婚者或有固定关系者）有外遇

strays.definition:
n an animal that has strayed (especially a domestic animal)
v move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment
v wander from a direct course or at random
v lose clarity or turn aside especially from the main subject of attention or course of argument in writing, thinking, or speaking
strays.translation: n. 迷失者（stray的复数形式）；天电杂散；天电干扰；杂散电容
